verdict: Ads are running and converting — but leads aren't reaching your CRM yet.
narrative: Google Ads delivered 10 recorded conversions on $927.81 in spend this period, but none of those leads are appearing in your CRM — this is a tracking and integration issue, not a drop in ad performance. The ads are working; the pipeline that captures and routes those leads is broken and is being repaired now. Google Business Profile activity also pulled back sharply this past week, with the last three days showing near-zero engagement, so local organic visibility is being monitored closely. An intake owner is being confirmed by tomorrow (August 31), which unblocks the speed-to-lead automations that have been stalled. Once the CRM connection is restored and intake ownership is set, leads will flow and be trackable again.

actions on your Google Business Profile this period — calls, direction requests, and website clicks

watch_item.issue: Zero leads are showing in your CRM despite confirmed ad conversions — the connection between Google Ads and your lead pipeline is broken.
watch_item.fix: The integration is being diagnosed and repaired this week; an intake owner is being confirmed by August 31 to ensure leads are routed and followed up on immediately once flow is restored.
